entries.text: Nightingale floors.

entries.text: Opening front door (even with a key) without making subtle adjustments to door gewgaws (gargoyle knocker, etc.) activates dart trap or other common dungeon-type trap when door’s opened.
entries.raw_text: 1,Opening front door (even with a key) without making subtle adjustments to door gewgaws (gargoyle knocker, etc.) activates dart trap or other common dungeon-type trap when door’s opened.

entries.text: Small, mildly/subtly exotic and monstrous pet – i.e. small, teal, carnivorous [Animal.Weirdsymbol], hypno-[Animal.Weirdsymbol], mutant plant, etc.
entries.raw_text: 1,Small, mildly/subtly exotic and monstrous pet – i.e. small, teal, carnivorous [Animal.Weirdsymbol], hypno-[Animal.Weirdsymbol], mutant plant, etc.

entries.text: Rat or other familiar through which resident or allied wizard will remotely notice intruders and cast spells. May bide its time and see what the intruders are all about.
entries.raw_text: 1,Rat or other familiar through which resident or allied wizard will remotely notice intruders and cast spells. May bide its time and see what the intruders are all about.

entries.text: Female attendants who are secret ninjas.
entries.raw_text: 1,Female attendants who are secret ninjas.

entries.text: The closet door near the front door is open. All other doors in the house are trapped. Closing the closet door (like the inhabitants do when they come home) deactivates the traps.
entries.raw_text: 1,The closet door near the front door is open. All other doors in the house are trapped. Closing the closet door (like the inhabitants do when they come home) deactivates the traps.

entries.text: Annoying Knox Harrington-esque visitor who just happens to be there when intruders show up (if they came in via b&e then assume the visitor’s unconscious on the sofa or something) and who assumes the PCs are friends, family or employees of the homeowner and generally behaves like a hilarious rube to the best of the DM’s ability.
entries.raw_text: 1,Annoying Knox Harrington-esque visitor who just happens to be there when intruders show up (if they came in via b&e then assume the visitor’s unconscious on the sofa or something) and who assumes the PCs are friends, family or employees of the homeowner and generally behaves like a hilarious rube to the best of the DM’s ability.

entries.text: Obviously egregiously valuable gold thingamabobber on pedestal near front door. Touching it activates a trap and/or it’s coated in poison. (Thingie’s actually worthless.)
entries.raw_text: 1,Obviously egregiously valuable gold thingamabobber on pedestal near front door. Touching it activates a trap and/or it’s coated in poison. (Thingie’s actually worthless.)

entries.text: No traps ''per se'', but the floors and/or walls are made of glass so if anybody is home they’ll notice the PCs.
entries.raw_text: 1,No traps ''per se'', but the floors and/or walls are made of glass so if anybody is home they’ll notice the PCs.

entries.text: Little girl (possibly red-headed) who just goes ''aaaaaaaaaaaah'' and runs away if she sees intruders. Maybe some guards show up.
entries.raw_text: 1,Little girl (possibly red-headed) who just goes ''aaaaaaaaaaaah'' and runs away if she sees intruders. Maybe some guards show up.

entries.text: Very old guests/parents, etc. at dining room table playing cards or eating soup, who think the PCs are there to fix the oven.
entries.raw_text: 1,Very old guests/parents, etc. at dining room table playing cards or eating soup, who think the PCs are there to fix the oven.

entries.text: The old monster-gargoyle-disguised-as-sculpture-gargoyle trick. A little one. Maybe it just follows you.
entries.raw_text: 1,The old monster-gargoyle-disguised-as-sculpture-gargoyle trick. A little one. Maybe it just follows you.

entries.text: All the doors to all the rooms are locked. And the locks are good. Breaking them probably makes noise and attracts somebody – guards, neighbors, the place’s owner, the dog – whatever.
entries.raw_text: 1,All the doors to all the rooms are locked. And the locks are good. Breaking them probably makes noise and attracts somebody – guards, neighbors, the place’s owner, the dog – whatever.

entries.text: No security measure ''per se'', but the only valuables in the house appear to be in the bedroom, along with a young and attractive NPC who’s tied up and gagged. Sophisticated PCs may realize that s/he’s not necessarily a prisoner.
entries.raw_text: 1,No security measure ''per se'', but the only valuables in the house appear to be in the bedroom, along with a young and attractive NPC who’s tied up and gagged. Sophisticated PCs may realize that s/he’s not necessarily a prisoner.
